style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big cobalt-blue vest, round glasses, red party cone, gold balloon 65 tied to his foot. Deadpan, never flies.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, red tie, 40th-floor window. ONE white rabbit with a glass, 39th-floor window. THREE hamster clerks, orange ties.
props: Shovel with a big red bow: mole's, its red ribbon wound round his wrist. Desk box with mug, cactus, photo frame: goose's. Coin: last clerk's. Cake: on the mole's sill.
environment: Pale pink glass tower, party flags on the open 40th-floor window; sunny-yellow tile courtyard, revolving glass door at the base.
lighting: Bright noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, magenta rim right. Cobalt vest pops against the pink tower; red cone, gold balloon, red bow vivid in every shot.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.4 s, beak free; no speech after 7.4 s

timeline.a: From the first frame: in the window the mole lowers his boot after a kick, bowed shovel under his arm, its red ribbon wound round his wrist; the goose falls head-first, wings hug the desk box.
timeline.c: swings past the mole's wrist, dives out the window after him

timeline.a: The box bursts: mug, cactus, frame swirl round him; he tucks the frame under his left wing, beak free; wings flick open and press back.
timeline.c: orbits him through the frozen swirl

timeline.a: Goose falls past the 39th-floor window, face unmoved; the rabbit raises his glass.
timeline.c: whips to the window, glass in foreground

timeline.a: His feet hit the tiles: tiles fan up, he sinks neck-deep; balloon 65 hangs above.
timeline.c: rockets back as tiles fan up

timeline.a: The cactus lands on his cone; balloon 65 sinks onto it and pops; he does not blink.
timeline.c: spins down with the cactus to his glasses, close-up

timeline.a: Clerks run into the revolving door, pitying faces turned to him; the last tosses a coin, it pings his glasses askew.
timeline.c: flies with the coin into his glasses, faces in foreground

timeline.a: Goose looks up; the bowed shovel jerks down the red ribbon from the 40th floor; his neck stretches up, tiles crack.
timeline.c: rises out of the hole past his beak

timeline.a: The shovel stops a finger above the hole; his right wingtip reaches the handle, a feather almost touching.
timeline.c: dives into the gap at the handle, close-up

timeline.a: Up top the mole jerks his wrist: the shovel yo-yos up out of the wing's reach; the mole catches it and cuts the cake in half with one blow.
timeline.c: hurls itself up the ribbon after the shovel to the mole's wrist, close-up

timeline.a: The mole lays the bowed shovel in the rabbit's paws below; the glass slips from the rabbit's paw. Last frame: rabbit's paws on the handle, the red ribbon still running up to the mole's wrist.
timeline.c: drops down the ribbon into the rabbit's paws, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, a flat medium shot, muted colors, dark scene, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
